text:
Maria G.: Quick follow-up from the KV eviction postmortem — we need a concrete testing + ownership plan so this doesn't recur.
Jonathan S.: +1. want a short list: regression case, nightly load, chaos eviction, and who owns each.
Devon K.: I can own the regression case and the promptset curation. aiming to have PR by EOD next Tue.
Maria G.: Awesome — can you add the PR link to the postmortem and the action tracker? cc @sre-bot to create the ticket.
sre-bot: Created ticket infra/REG-489: "kv-cache eviction regression + night-load" --> https://redwood.example/in/REG-489 :white_check_mark:
Alex P.: For the nightly load, I propose a lightweight k8s job that spins up demo load (10k tokens/min) + a small chaos pod that triggers cache flush intermittently. low-cost.
Sam T.: Suggest we include both short prefix-heavy prompts and long-completion prompts in the promptset. the failure was triggered by mid-sequence evictions.
Devon K.: Draft of regression test plan pasted below:
```
- regression-suite: ops/kv-eviction-regression
- cases:
  - prefix-heavy (100k calls/day synthetic)
  - long-seq (seq_len 4096 with intermittent KV flush)
  - mixed-concurrency (10 concurrent streams with varying seq lengths)
- owners: Devon K. (cases + promptset), Alex P. (nightly load job), Maria G. (rollout gating)
- target: merge + green CI by 2024-07-12
```
Maria G.: Dates look good. Can we also add an automated smoke check in the canary rollout to validate KV hit rates?
Alex P.: Yes. I'll add a canary probe that checks cache_hit_ratio > 0.85 for 2m window, if not -> rollback. snippet: 
```yaml
canary_probe:
  metric: cache_hit_ratio
  threshold: 0.85
  window: 120s
  action: rollback
```
Jonathan S.: How do we track regression flakiness? we should record failing prompts and make them non-flaky over time.
Devon K.: Plan: failing prompts get copied into per-test artifacts bucket; nightly job replays failing ones first and marks owners. I'll add retention 90d.
Sam T.: Also recommend adding a small chaos drill in the quarterly runbook for this class of failures. basically: simulate random KV evictions during peak load.
Maria G.: Agreed. Add to Q3 chaos drill roster. owner: Sam T.
Devon K.: One more thing — quantization+new kernel combo was correlated in the incident. I'll add a test axis for model variants (float16, q4_0) in the regression matrix.
Alex P.: Thumbs up. low extra cost but high signal.
Jonathan S.: Can the postmortem link make this checklist visible in the action tracker? I want daily progress updates until all items are closed.
Maria G.: Yes — I'll add a checklist to REG-489 and pin weekly status updates to the postmortem thread.
sre-bot: Reminder: scheduled task created — nightly regression job (ops/kv-eviction-regression) -> cron 0 3 * * * UTC
Devon K.: I'll open the initial PR and tag folks. thanks everyone.
Alex P.: +1 :rocket:
Sam T.: :eyes: will add chaos drill steps to the runbook.
Maria G.: Closing the loop — owners: Devon (regression + promptset), Alex (nightly & canary probes), Sam (chaos drill), Maria (postmortem gating & weekly updates). target closure: 2024-07-19.
Jonathan S.: Sounds good. logging it in the action tracker now.
Maria G.: If anything blocks owners, ping here. thanks.
